9.3 Network shutdown (CAN)
Figure 9.3 shows the possibilities to shutdown the CAN network. It can be either ini-
tiated if the last user releases his COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION request or ComM_
LimitChannelToNoComMode (see [SWS_ComM_00163]) is called. The behaviour
is equal for LIN, FlexRay and Ethernet just with different API names.
